description: Use this slot to report the lower limit of detection if available
Use this slot to report the upper limit of detection, if available
This slot will always have a CURIE from OMOP, OBA, NCIT, EFO, etc.

This slot will be an identifier to a File, QuestionnaireResponse, or Assay. Use this to link a measurement observation to an entity that generated it. For example, a CESD score should have a link to the QuestionnaireResponse from which it is derived.
Use this slot to specify where on the body a measurement was taken. For example, blood pressure can be measured from multiple places on the body. This will always be a CURIE from uberon.

Use this slot to specify what position the Participant was in when the measurement was taken in those instances where those are relevant. Examples include blood pressure and height. Body position does not matter for measurements resulting from blood or urine assays, for example.
The patient is in a sitting position during the measurement or observation
The patient is in a standing position during the measurement or observation
The patient is lying on their back during the measurement or observation
The patient is lying on their stomach during the measurement or observation
Use this slot to specify the occupation of the person who collected the measurement. This is often specified for blood pressure measurements.
A medical doctor (MD) or doctor of osteopathic medicine (DO)
A registered nurse (RN), licensed practical nurse (LPN), or other nursing professional
A healthcare worker trained to perform specific technical tasks
Any other type of healthcare professional involved in performing an activity
An average or mean of measurements taken across a time period

The minimum value among measurements taken across a time period. Sometimes a measurement will be listed as best or worst. Whether or not this translates to a minimum or maximum depends on the measurements and what it means for disease state or organ function.

The maximum value among measurements taken across a time period. Sometimes a measurement will be listed as best or worst. Whether or not this translates to a minimum or maximum depends on the measurements and what it means for disease state or organ function.
The sum of measurements taken across a time period
The first measurement taken in a series of measurements across a time period.
The last measurement taken in a series of measurements across a time period.
Use this slot to link a MeasurementObservation to a specific visit or exam.
Use this slot to link a MeasurementObservation to a specific Participant

Use this slot to specify the age of the Participant at the time of the MeasurementObservation. This will often be the same as the age at visit, but not always. An example, is when a Participant gives a weight at a specific, previous age.
Use this slot to specify the method used to make the observation. Examples include anthropometry, ultrasound, CBC, and calculation.
Use this slot to specify the Organization that performed the measurement. This will often be a clinic or an analytical lab.
Use this slot to contain the value of the MeasurementObservation if that value is a String.
Use this slot to contain the value of the MeasurementObservation if that value is a Boolean.
Use this slot to contain the value of the MeasurementObservation if that value is an Integer or Decimal.
Use this slot to contain the value of the MeasurementObservation if that value is an Enum.
Use this slot to specify any relevant context for the MeasurementObservation. For example, this can record if the measurement was taken relative to fasting, exercise, or taking a bronchodilator.
This entity is the range for range_low, range_high, and value_quantity slots. It will contain a numerical value and the metadata about that value.
Use this slot to contain float numbers
Use this slot to contain integers. Many scores can only be integer values.
Use this slot to contain values that are not enumerative, but also are not numbers. For example, a range like 3.4-8.0 would go here.
Use this slot to hold the unit represented as UCUM
Use this slot when the value is reported as being greater than or less than a number
The quantity is less than a specified value
The quantity is less than or equal to a specified value
The quantity is equal to a specified value - this will be rarely, if ever used
The quantity is greater than or equal to a specified value
The quantity is greater than a specified value
This entity is the range for context
Use this slot to specify the type of activity
Use this slot to specify when the activity occurred relative to the measurement being taken
Occurring later than
Occurring prior to
Occurring simultaneous to
This entity is the range for the activity slot
Use this slot to specify the type of activity
Abstaining from intake of food or liquid
The act of taking one or more medication in the class of "bronchodilators"
The act of taking one or more medication used in control of diabetes
The act of taking one or more medication in the class of "antihyperlipidemics...
The act of engaging in aerobic movement
When did the measurement occur in relation to a therapeutic or diagnostic procedure undertaken in the context of healthcare or research
Use this slot to specify the duration of the activity. For example if the fasting was for 8 hours or 12 hours.
